verification_report.summary: The complete proof passes all 56 sequential deduction checks under the accepted inputs. The exact Guan–Li application, including arbitrary nonclosed background and normalization, is supported by [Theorem 1.1 in the primary PDF](https://people.math.osu.edu/guan.19/Papers/Guan-Li.aim.pdf). Uniform barriers, translated comparison, uniform limits, contraction, and domination are valid. Maximality is established for the constructed solution; uniqueness among all homogeneous solutions is not asserted. See the [full readable audit](/Users/mingchen/Non-Kahler/research/rethlas/verification/results/local_homogeneous_dirichlet_01/verification_report.md).
